name: Song of Serenity
body:
School conjuration (healing); Level bard 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You channel positive energy through your song, rejuvenating a fatigued target. You must sing for 1 round and touch the target while singing for the spell to take effect. The fatigued subject is immediately rejuvenated.
